Hunting protected migratory birds, using prohibited methods, or hunting out of season violates Lebanese environmental law. Lebanon is a major bird migration corridor, making hunting regulation especially important.
laws.penalty: Fine; up to 1 year imprisonment; confiscation of weapons and catch
exceptions: Scientific research hunting under special permits

quiz.q: What makes hunting regulation particularly important in Lebanon ecological context?
options: Lebanon has no forests for hunting
Lebanon is a major bird migration corridor
All Lebanese bird species are endangered
Hunting is the main tourist activity
quiz.explanation: Lebanon position on a major bird migration route between Africa and Europe makes hunting regulation especially important for bird conservation.

laws.title: Forced Sterilization
laws.subtitle: Performing sterilization procedures without full consent
laws.fullDescription: Lebanese medical and criminal law prohibits performing sterilization procedures on individuals without their full, free, and informed consent. Non-consensual sterilization violates bodily autonomy and reproductive rights.
laws.penalty: Hard labor for up to 10 years
exceptions: Medically necessary procedures with full informed consent
Emergency procedures to preserve life
laws.sourceLabel: Lebanese Penal Code — Crimes Against Bodily Integrity

quiz.q: What makes sterilization without consent criminal in Lebanon?
options: Violation of bodily autonomy and reproductive rights
Only if performed by unlicensed doctors
quiz.explanation: Forced sterilization violates fundamental bodily autonomy and reproductive rights, making it a serious criminal offense under Lebanese law.

laws.title: Unauthorized Interception of Communications
laws.subtitle: Wiretapping or monitoring communications without authorization
laws.fullDescription: Lebanese law prohibits the unauthorized interception of telephone calls, emails, and other private communications. Only law enforcement agencies acting under judicial authorization may intercept communications. Unauthorized interception violates privacy rights.
laws.penalty: Fine; up to 2 years imprisonment
exceptions: Law enforcement interception under valid judicial warrant
Parental monitoring of minor children within reasonable limits

quiz.q: Under what condition may law enforcement intercept private communications in Lebanon?
quiz.explanation: Lebanese law requires a valid judicial warrant for law enforcement to intercept private communications, ensuring judicial oversight.

laws.title: Rocket and Missile Possession
laws.subtitle: Civilians owning military rockets or missiles
laws.fullDescription: Lebanese law prohibits civilian possession of rockets, missiles, and rocket-propelled weapons. This law is politically sensitive given Hezbollah large missile arsenal, but formally applies to civilian possession outside state and faction control.
laws.penalty: Hard labor; up to 15 years imprisonment
exceptions: Official Lebanese Armed Forces

quiz.q: What makes rocket possession law politically complex in Lebanon?
options: Hezbollah operates a large missile arsenal outside state control
Rockets are only regulated for export
The law was never formally enacted
quiz.explanation: Lebanon formal law prohibiting civilian rocket possession is politically complicated by Hezbollah large missile arsenal operating outside Lebanese Armed Forces.

laws.title: Black Market Currency Exchange
laws.subtitle: Exchanging currency at illegal parallel market rates
laws.fullDescription: Lebanon currency crisis has created a vast black market for foreign currency exchange. While demand for USD at parallel market rates reflects real economic pressures, operating as an unlicensed currency exchange dealer outside the formal system is technically illegal.
laws.penalty: Fine; possible imprisonment for large-scale operators
exceptions: Small personal currency transactions below threshold amounts

quiz.q: What underlying crisis created Lebanon vast black market currency exchange?
options: Lebanon currency crisis and financial collapse
quiz.explanation: Lebanon catastrophic financial crisis and currency collapse drove millions of transactions to the black market currency exchange as the official system failed.

laws.title: Exploiting Conflict for Looting
laws.subtitle: Stealing property during periods of civil unrest
laws.fullDescription: Lebanese criminal law imposes enhanced penalties for theft and looting committed during periods of civil unrest, natural disaster, or other crisis. Exploiting vulnerability created by chaos to steal from unguarded properties is treated more seriously than ordinary theft.
laws.penalty: Hard labor for up to 10 years; enhanced from ordinary theft penalties
exceptions: None — looting during crises is always an aggravated offense

quiz.q: How does Lebanese law treat theft committed during civil unrest compared to ordinary theft?
options: As an aggravated offense with enhanced penalties
Only as a civil matter during unrest
quiz.explanation: Lebanese law treats looting during civil unrest as an aggravated theft offense, imposing enhanced penalties for exploiting crisis conditions.

laws.title: Toxic Chemical Dumping
laws.subtitle: Illegally disposing of industrial chemicals in the environment
laws.fullDescription: Lebanese environmental law prohibits dumping toxic chemicals in the environment — in soil, waterways, or coastal waters. Industrial facilities must dispose of chemical waste through licensed treatment facilities. Unauthorized chemical dumping poses serious public health and environmental risks.
laws.penalty: Fine; up to 5 years imprisonment; mandatory remediation
exceptions: Approved chemical disposal through licensed hazardous waste treatment facilities
laws.sourceLabel: Lebanese Environment Protection Act — Chemical Waste

quiz.q: Where must Lebanese industrial facilities dispose of toxic chemical waste?
options: Through licensed hazardous waste treatment facilities
quiz.explanation: Lebanese law requires all toxic chemical waste to be disposed of through licensed hazardous waste treatment facilities, not released into the environment.

laws.title: Crimes Against Human Dignity
laws.subtitle: Acts that fundamentally violate human dignity and rights
laws.fullDescription: Lebanese law and international human rights obligations prohibit acts that fundamentally violate human dignity — including torture, degrading treatment, and humiliation of detainees or prisoners. Lebanon ratification of international human rights conventions reinforces these domestic protections.
laws.penalty: Hard labor; up to 15 years imprisonment
exceptions: None — violations of fundamental human dignity admit no justification
laws.sourceLabel: Lebanese Penal Code and International Human Rights Obligations

quiz.q: What international commitments reinforce Lebanon domestic laws protecting human dignity?
options: Lebanon ratification of international human rights conventions
No international commitments reinforce domestic law
quiz.explanation: Lebanon ratification of key international human rights conventions reinforces domestic legal protections for human dignity and prohibitions on degrading treatment.
